property_summary: For every recipient and caller, once getFirstWithdrawalBonus(recipient) completes on a contract holding exactly the 100-wei reward, the 100 wei must have been transferred out so that address(c).balance becomes 0; the mutant sends 0 wei, leaving the contract still holding 100 wei, violating the rule.
change_summary: Replace the amount computation with `uint amountToWithdraw = 0;` so no value is ever sent.
